backend.source_model_description: Client-only JavaScript/Bootstrap issuing live SPARQL templates to an endpoint; compressed sessionStorage cache; DataGraft integration

tasks: Three Norwegian cadastral scenarios after20min introduction
151 standalone and375 DataGraft analytics users; not study sample
17 tool feasibility checks; no human baseline comparison

descriptions.interaction: Configure endpoint/named graph; inspect overview and namespaces; drill through class hierarchy; browse paginated class instances; inspect direct/inverse links; search labels
descriptions.guidance: Rank classes by direct-subclass/member counts, provide hierarchy/breadcrumbs and type-specific views; bootstrap structural information lazily
descriptions.visualisation: Form/list-based dataset and class views; individual details, pictures and maps where available; consistent bookmarkable resource URLs
descriptions.backend: Client-only JavaScript/Bootstrap issuing live SPARQL templates to an endpoint; compressed sessionStorage cache; DataGraft integration
descriptions.evaluation: Deployment analytics and operation latency; separate single-system usability study; author-run tool-feasibility comparison

report_level_evaluation.design: Deployment analytics and operation latency; separate single-system usability study; author-run tool-feasibility comparison
report_level_evaluation.participants: usability n: 14; background: Data scientists;4 almost no LinkedData/SPARQL,8 with1–3years/basic SPARQL,2 with>3years/good SPARQL
report_level_evaluation.tasks: After~20min introduction,3 Norwegian cadastral exploration scenarios over1.3M triples; author comparison follows DBpediaArtwork/Breda navigation scenario
report_level_evaluation.comparators: No usability control;17 exploration tools assessed for availability and support of one DBpedia scenario
report_level_evaluation.measures: SUS, open feedback and impression ratings; GoogleAnalytics uptake/operation time; scenario completion/feasibility of alternative tools
report_level_evaluation.results: Mean SUS65(SD16);least-experienced group mean51 vs most-experienced80. Standalone151 users/287 sessions/47 repositories;DataGraft375/531/61(Nov2019).13/17 tools ran;only4 alternatives worked on DBpedia, with limited exploration support.; limits: Small self-selected technical sample and domain-unfamiliar/no-label cadastral dataset; experience groups not randomized. Usage figures are analytics identifiers, not study participants. Tool comparison is an author-run dated scenario, not a controlled user comparison.; Current querying is limited to label searches; supporting faceted search is future work.; Intended lay-user suitability is not uniformly supported: novices rated usability lower.
report_level_evaluation.limitations: Small self-selected technical sample and domain-unfamiliar/no-label cadastral dataset; experience groups not randomized. Usage figures are analytics identifiers, not study participants. Tool comparison is an author-run dated scenario, not a controlled user comparison.; Current querying is limited to label searches; supporting faceted search is future work.; Intended lay-user suitability is not uniformly supported: novices rated usability lower.
